claims.statement: Rhee reported approving martial law and proposing Pusan be included.
claims.note: Two US diplomatic memoranda record the president's own account. Korean cabinet minutes and written order still needed.

claims.statement: A 1952-05-27 US diplomatic telegram reports that the martial-law commander was to take orders directly from the president.
claims.note: The reported arrangement is not proof of any specific subsequent instruction.

claims.statement: US representatives formally requested that martial law be lifted in Pusan on May 30, 1952.
